endorsements.label: Pwn2Own Toronto 2022 - Day One Results
endorsements.description: Tri Dang and Bien Pham (@bienpnn) from Qrious Secure were able to execute 2 bugs (authentication bypass and command injectiong) attack against the WAN interface of TP-Link AX1800 in the Router category. They earn $20K and 2 Master of Pwn points.
